notes: SHIP v1.14.394 - ONE LIVE RACK, AND IT BELONGS TO BUILD. The device diagnostic shipped in .390 did its job and named the real cause: "no webgl context granted (after 12 re-arms)", with rack u1:002 resolved, host present at 376x320, clientWidth 376, clientHeight 320, three.js loaded, WebGL supported and a dispose hook live. iOS Safari was never failing to lay the box out - .392 fixed that - it was REFUSING A SECOND LIVE CONTEXT because the Command hero already held one. TWO CORRECTIONS, BOTH FROM THE OWNER RULING. (1) COMMAND SURRENDERS THE LIVE RACK. Command is a situational overview and does not need a live WebGL renderer; it now uses the existing DOM elevation via cmd_rackHeroFlat. This is the ruled presentation, not a degraded fallback, and it frees the single context iOS grants so Build - the primary interactive rack workspace - can hold it. cmd_rackHero3D is RETAINED and unused rather than deleted, because deleting a renderer on a live-fix ship is not this ship. (2) A REFUSED CONTEXT IS NO LONGER RE-ARMED. Re-arming a refused getContext asks a starved browser for yet another context, which worsens the pressure instead of recovering from it - exactly as the owner identified. That path now fails once, loudly, and names the cause on the card. Re-arming is kept for LAYOUT, which it genuinely fixes. THIS IS A LIVE FIX, NOT THE ARCHITECTURE. The authorized RackExperience consolidation - one canonical controller owning open, setView, setCablesVisible, enterAisle, exitAisle, detach and dispose, with Open Aisle as an expanded mode of the same engine rather than a second application, and Rack Map and tool cards never silently creating contexts - is a real architecture ship that must be planned and executed as its own program with a full OODA pass. It is NOT attempted here. What this ship does is remove the second live context that was starving the primary one, which is the precondition for that consolidation and the fix the device needs today. SCENE UNTOUCHED - lighting, materials, geometry, fog, camera direction, floor, reflection, tone mapping, tray geometry and TYPE_COLORS are exactly as they were. STILL OPEN: the RackExperience consolidation; an audit of every remaining WebGL context owner (forge3d / Open Aisle / Rack Map / any tool card); the bottom nav fourth item reading EXIT where the reference shows SHIFT; the rack control rail wrapping 4-then-1 with REAR and EXPLODE absent from the reference; and the metrics layout still unverified against a Master-linked rack. DEVICE-VERIFY: cold load, open Build, confirm the rack draws on the FIRST open. Command now shows the DOM elevation rather than a live 3D rack - that is intended. If Build still reports a refused context, a THIRD context owner is alive and the card will say so.
